directions: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students far its coming edition on a campus event that has impressed them most. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Among numerous campus events, the annual campus charity fair has left the deepest impression on me.

To begin with, it fosters a strong sense of community. Students from various majors and backgrounds come together to set up stalls, sell handmade crafts, and offer services. For example, my classmates and I made and sold cookies, and we interacted with many other students, strengthening our bonds. In addition, it is a great platform for students to develop practical skills. We need to plan, organize, and promote our stalls, which enhances our communication and management abilities. Moreover, the fair is meaningful as it raises funds for those in need. The money we collected was donated to local orphanages, bringing joy and hope to the children.

In conclusion, the campus charity fair is not only a fun event but also a valuable opportunity for personal growth and social contribution, which is why it has impressed me so much.
